Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive) ♦ Install: Hospital

Humanity Loss: 7 (2d6)

“What do I look like, a newbie? Of course I can get into the datafort. That I’m missing an arm has nothing to do with my net skills.”

Neuralware. Penalties to Actions the user is suffering from any Critical Injury or Wound State are halved for all Interface Checks. Once per Round, if the user would come under the effect of any Program or Black ICE effect that reduces INT, REF, DEX, the amount of Net Actions available, or incurs a penalty to any type of Interface Check, the user may activate this Cyberware to negate its effect (but not damage).

Type: Neuralware
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 1

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Neuralware).
